failure_mode: HTTP 404 on every interaction sub-endpoint: /json/interactions, /tsv/interactions, /json/network and /json/interaction_partners. /json/resolve still answers 200.
root_cause: STITCH retired its interaction API while keeping identifier resolution. Probed 2026-10-03: resolve returns 200 with real data for 'aspirin', and the four interaction paths all return a 196-byte Apache 404 page. An /api/v5/ prefix 404s too, and https on stitch.embl.de fails TLS, so there is no moved path to follow.
retry_notes: GET http://stitch.embl.de/api/json/interaction_partners?identifiers=aspirin . A 200 means the interaction API is back. STITCH_resolve_identifier is unaffected and still passes, so a failure there would be a separate problem.
workaround: None that answers the same question. STRING serves https://string-db.org/api/json/interaction_partners and returns 200 for identifiers=aspirin, which looks like a drop-in replacement and is not one: STRING holds no chemicals, so it fuzzy-matched 'aspirin' to the gene SLC17A4 and returned that gene's protein-protein interactions (SLC17A4-SLC17A1 at score 0.952, and nine more). Repointing there would answer a different question with confident-looking data, which is worse than the 404. Checked before writing this down.
investigation_notes: Found in the 2026-10-03 sweep as 4 failures under the stitch category. The tools already report the 404 clearly (Fix-R19E-3), so they stay registered rather than being removed: a caller asking for chemical-protein interactions learns the upstream is gone, which is the honest answer. STITCH_resolve_identifier continues to work.
